system.name: CampusGuide (fictional)

out_of_scope_uses: automated admissions, scholarship, discipline, or eligibility decisions
processing real student records or confidential documents
replacing an official policy or a human adviser
system.jurisdiction_note: Fictional exercise; no jurisdictional or legal classification performed.

The example says nothing about factuality, bias, robustness, or quality of a real model.

dataset_cards.name: fictional course and scholarship rule examples
dataset_cards.source: Hand-authored synthetic rows created for this chapter; not copied from an institution.
dataset_cards.collection_method: Manual construction for schema testing; no scraping or user submissions.

No sampling, language-coverage, quality, or rights review is claimed.

risk_register.scenario: A reader mistakes an example explanation for a final scholarship-eligibility decision.
controls: Show a clear boundary and route unresolved questions to an accountable adviser.

risk_register.scenario: A future deployment receives real student records or retains more personal information than required.
controls: Block real-record use until a separate, authorized privacy and retention review is completed.

risk_register.scenario: A policy example becomes stale or is interpreted outside its publication context.
controls: Record a named content owner and review date.
Link to a current official source in any real system and provide a correction route.

risk_register.scenario: People using an untested language or assistive technology receive less useful guidance.
controls: Do not claim language or accessibility coverage without scoped testing.
Offer a human route and document which populations have not been evaluated.

decision.rationale: Synthetic teaching fixture only; no real legal, privacy, model, user, or operational evidence has been reviewed, so no deployment approval is requested or implied.
